region: Yadda ake liƙa rubutun a cikin wakilin ku

scenes.title: Kwafi rubutun
scenes.caption: A cikin Leafen, “Kwafi rubutu” yana kwafin rubutu mai ɗauke da lambar amfani guda ɗaya don haɗawa.

scenes.title: Liƙa shi a cikin wakilin ku
scenes.caption: Kuna liƙa shi a cikin wakili kamar Claude Code ko Codex sannan ku danna Enter.

scenes.title: Ba shi izinin gudana
scenes.caption: Wakilin yana ƙara Leafen da kansa. Idan ya nemi a gudanar da umarni, ku zaɓi “Yes”.

scenes.title: An haɗa
scenes.caption: Lokacin da Leafen ya nuna sunan wakilin, an haɗa.

mock.agentStart: Zan haɗa zuwa Leafen. Da farko, zan musanya lambar amfani guda ɗaya da maɓalli.
mock.agentDone: An haɗa zuwa Leafen. Yaya kuke so ku fara: matsar da wurin aikin ku na Notion zuwa nan, ko fara daga wurin aiki mara komai?
mock.agentDoneConnected: An haɗa da Leafen. Yanzu za ka iya amfani da shi a wannan tattaunawa.

shows: Liƙa rubutun a cikin wakili yana haɗa shi kamar haka
